mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate sustained monetary accommodation without immediate tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market health, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate declines and unemployment rate increases signal coordinated policy response to economic weakness, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days as stimulus expectations rise.
failure_condition: The joint signal of falling FEDFUNDS and rising UNRATE fails to predict positive 20d returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-pandemic recovery regimes, rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer confidence and construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, HOUST growth fails to predict positive 20d returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Robust industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing output and supply chain resilience, supporting positive S&P 500 returns as corporate earnings growth accelerates within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive 20d returns in more than 50% of expansionary periods.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly retail sales growth exceeding 0.5% signals strong consumer spending momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations rise.
failure_condition: When RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% in 1 month, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth combined with stable interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) indicates a robust economy without imminent policy tightening, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During post-shock labor market recovery, strong nonfarm payroll growth (PAYEMS) reflects accelerating employment conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic normalization progresses.
failure_condition: In the post-shock labor market recovery regime, PAYEMS growth fails to predict positive 60d returns in more than 50% of cases.
